payload_readiness_component.policy: Generation coverage excludes not_available_in_payload requirements. Payload readiness is reported separately for audit.

coverage_component.policy: Generation coverage excludes not_available_in_payload requirements. Payload readiness is reported separately for audit.

new_section_generation_score.scoring_policy: Coverage uses deterministic supported-scope evidence mapping. LLM judges are a separate quality signal. Payload readiness is reported separately and missing synthetic payload items do not lower the generation score.

change_summary: Tightened the basis of preparation narrative to align more explicitly with IFRS S1 fair presentation and decision-useful characteristics, while keeping wording neutral and audit-style.
Consolidated reporting period, fiscal year-end, and currency into a single, clearer presentation and aligned currency references consistently to EUR and €m.

Strengthened the ‘connected information’ subsection by explicitly linking the risk register and scenario analysis evidence to cross-pillar connectivity without adding new governance or process claims.
Removed unsupported operational emissions and green loan figures from the ‘Selected 2024 metrics’ list and retained only metrics evidenced in the provided context.
Improved table quality by adding a populated multi-year comparatives table and a concise topic locator table to support navigation and connectivity.
Streamlined methodology descriptions and retained only scenario methodology and resilience statements evidenced in the provided scenario notes.

policy: Approved sections below target are refined once using supported evidence, then re-checked through claims, deterministic gates, judges and approval. Refined text is kept only when it improves safely.
